chunks: And it has been narrated in another report:
Whenever a woman remains with her husband after she has learned that he is impotent and she accepts him as he is, she no longer has any option after acceptance.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: consent or acceptance after knowing the condition
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the wife whose legal choice is being discussed
key_terms.خَبَرٍ: a report or narration conveying the ruling
key_terms.خِيَارٌ: the legal option or right to choose separation
key_terms.رَضِيَتْ: she accepted and was content with the situation
key_terms.زَوْجِهَا: her husband within the marital relationship
key_terms.عَلِمَتْ: she came to know with awareness of the husband's condition

ai.seo_question: Does a woman retain the option to separate if she stays with an impotent husband after knowingly accepting his condition?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal ruling concerning marriage and the right of choice in the case of an impotent husband. It states that if the woman knows of his condition and consents to remain with him, her right to later seek separation on that basis is no longer upheld.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4898 - It is narrated in another report:
"Whenever a woman continues to live with her husband after knowing that he is impotent and she accepts him in that condition, she no longer has the option to separate from him after her acceptance."
